directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: Now the whole Zone knows that the anarchist leaders are dead. And that pleases me very much! You must probably think that I'm general Voronin in a disguise, don't you? Ha-ha... You are wrong! How general Voronin will try to disguise himself now - I don't know, but he is your next target. He and colonel Petrenko...

entries.JA_new: 今じゃゾーン中に、無政府主義者の指導者が死んだって知れ渡った。実に喜ばしい！ まさか俺を、変装したヴォロニン将軍だと思ってるんじゃないか？ はは……違うさ！ これから将軍がどう変装するかは知らんが、次の標的はそいつだ。ペトレンコ大佐もな……

entries.EN: Wow, the greatness of your tasks is worth admiration. So, what have the Duty leaders done to spite you?
entries.JA_current: Wow, the greatness of your tasks is worth admiration. So, what have the Duty leaders done to spite you?
entries.JA_new: すごい仕事ばかりだな。今度はデューティーの指導者に何の恨みがある？

entries.EN: You see, behind the apparent purity, bravery and righteousness behind Duty's mantra, the whole organization is corrupted with rot. In fact, Duty is nothing but an agent of the government, a deniable proxy who's only objective is the suppression and exploitation of the Zone at the expense of everyone else. And WE are a part of "everyone else". All stalkers, me and you. Don't ask where this information comes from. Believe me, it's true. Do you take the job?

entries.JA_new: デューティーは表向き、清廉で勇敢、正義を重んじると謳っているが、組織の中は腐りきってる。実態は政府の手先だ。政府が表立って関与せず、ゾーンを抑え込み、そこにいる連中を犠牲にして搾取するためのな。俺たちはその「連中」の一部だ。ストーカー全員、あんたも俺もな。この情報の出どころは聞くな。間違いないと信じてくれ。仕事を受けるか？

graph_nodes.EN: I need a job. Do you have something for me?
graph_nodes.JA_current: 仕事が必要なんだ。何かないか？
